Container.Name: ParsippanySlides
Container.Overview: Announcement slides editor with a live lobby screen, a desk remote, and a sponsorship digest for Telegram. Editor at /, lobby screen at /play, desk remote at /remote.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the editor, the lobby screen (/play), and the desk remote (/remote).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Room state and Telegram settings. Decks and images live in the Sponsorship Slides Archive path.

Config.Name: Sponsorship Slides Archive
Config.Description: Decks, uploaded images, and the deck library index. Point this at the AVMandal Files share. Must be writable by PUID/PGID. This folder is never uploaded to GitHub or GHCR.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner user ID for the appdata files (99 = nobody on unRAID). Set 0 if the appdata filesystem refuses ownership changes.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Owner group ID for the appdata files (100 = users on unRAID).
